entries.en: Stand the dominos anywhere inside the continuous curve band, in order along the curve. Push the first one so the chain of contacts rings the bell. Repair fallen or stalled segments using as few pushes as possible.
entries.zh: 在连续曲线带内任意位置、沿曲线按顺序立起多米诺骨牌，推倒第一块，通过接触连锁敲响铃铛，并用尽量少的推动次数修复倒下或卡住的段。

goal_recipe.easy:
Goal: Stand the dominos anywhere inside the continuous curve band, in order along the curve. Push the first one so the chain of contacts rings the bell. Repair fallen or stalled segments using as few pushes as possible.

TASK RECIPE:
Five dominos; at most eight legal pushes.

Stand and release all dominos inside the visible curved band in curve order until a stable setup is registered. For setup, keep each domino upright with its local up-axis vertical component greater than 0.99, and align its local horizontal axis with the curve tangent (absolute dot product greater than 0.98). Keep every footprint within the band, supported by the table, released and still for 60 physics ticks (0.5 simulated seconds). Do not push the first domino before this complete setup has registered. There are no individual target slots. Push the first domino to start the contact chain. For a stalled chain, wait at least 360 physics ticks without progress; a restart at a later domino requires every preceding domino to have fallen. Do not touch the bell, its clapper, or a domino while it is falling. Initial pushes and permitted restarts share the eight-push budget. A completed setup is a historical event: legal toppling does not invalidate it. Only evidenced legal activations and contact propagation count toward progress.

Scoring (highest eligible stage; stages are not added):
0: No valid complete setup was ever registered, any illegal contact/restart occurs, or more than eight pushes are used.
10: A valid complete setup was registered, but no higher stage is met. Legal toppling does not erase this historical setup.
20: After legal pushes and contact propagation, the valid fallen prefix from the first domino reaches 3 dominos, but strict success is not achieved.
100: All dominos legally topple within eight pushes and the last contacts the bell to reach its ringing angle, including a shell-clapper strike when that mechanism is used, with no illegal contact.
